''Welcome to a simpler QuakeWorld server experience.'' == Description == If you want to setup a modern, fully featured QuakeWorld server, either in Windows or Linux, nQuakesv is everything you need. It will install and run the server(s) straight away. === Features === * Linux and Windows support * start and stop servers scripts * update maps script * update binaries script * update server configs script * allows running different [[ktx]] mods in each port === Contents === * [[MVDSV]] * [[ktx]] * [[QuakeTV]] * [[QWfwd]] === Development === * Project lead: [[Empezar]] * '''Other Notable Contributors:''' ** [[Image:flag_pt.gif]] [[Mushi]] — config tweaking ** [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Ake_Vader]] — updates == External links == * [http://nquake.com/ nQuake homepage] * [http://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/5827/introducing-nquakesv Introducing nQuakesv] thread on Quakeworld.nu [[Category:Packages]]
